meta.purpose: what did I miss: Speaker B

sentences.text: Speaker B says iPods now have touch scroll buttons like what they're describing and that might be something to look into, and finds the idea of a kinetic battery that works by shaking interesting but thinks solar would not be a good idea for a remote. c001
Speaker B wants to use a simple or regular chip to keep costs down and says they only need a regular or advanced chip if they use an LCD, and wants to avoid making things overly technological. c001
